messages:
emily: Quick sync to lock the SI trainer sandbox runbook for the pilot (cloud marketplace + on-prem kit). Need owners for tokens, NDAs, trainer schedule, and the announcement embargo. Short answers please.

omar: I can provision sandbox accounts and short-lived tokens. Require partner email CSV and a list of extension requests.

julia: Compiling partner CSV now. Also noted partners asking for GPU clarity in docs (A100 vs H100). Recommend we publish a single recommended spec and mark alternatives.

emily: Recommend H100 for heavy multi-model tests, A100 as fallback. Add a caveat that perf numbers are sample-only.

nate: Draft training agenda: Day1 infra & kit bringup, Day2 model serve + perf tuning, Day3 troubleshooting + handoff checklist. I put slides in drive (DM link).

partner-bot: Automated check: NDAs required for shipments. Pending: "Pioneer Integrations", "BlueSpan SI".

maria: I'll escalate pending NDAs to legal and share a secure upload link. We should not ship to partners without signed NDA.

omar: Tokens default to 7-day expiry. Approve 14-day tokens for trainer accounts only? I'll log extensions.

emily: Approved for trainer accounts only. Track requester and reason.

zack: Trainer materials: swapping old CLI examples from `redwood deploy --region us-west` to `redwood deploy --env=staging`. Also adding a small disk cleanup card (`df -h`, clean /tmp).

julia: Created single tracker sheet with columns: partner, email, nda_status, kit_shipped, trainer, cert_status. Link: drive.redwood.com/si-trainer-runbook-tracker (shared).

emily: Certification: badge if partner completes 4 labs, proctor checklist, and a short case study (<=500 words). Maria, OK?

maria: Sounds good. Proctor checklist draft accepted. Also propose embargo from ship date until partner signs off (max 14 days).

zack: Proctor checklist snippet:
- verify kit boots and agent connects to control plane
- run 3-minute sample workload and capture TTF
- confirm model loads with target quant profile
- collect logs and upload to drive

omar: TTF targets: on-prem kits <350ms, marketplace instances <140ms. Take median of 3 runs. If >30% over, file eng-ml ticket with logs.

emily: Good. Marketing sync: Nate to own timeline and joint announcement checklist (quotes, logos, legal signoff).

nate: Will schedule and share timeline by Fri.

emily: Action recap: Omar = provisioning & tokens; Julia = partner CSV & tracker; Maria = NDAs + badge criteria; Nate = marketing timeline; Zack = slides & proctor checklist. I'll collate into a single handoff doc and post back.

partner-bot: Calendar event created: "SI Trainer Sandbox Runbook" Tue 11:00 PT. Invites sent.

emily: Closing thread 1 but post blockers here so we keep a single source of truth.
